headword: {総支給額|そうしきゅうがく}
gloss: gross pay; total amount paid before deductions

definitions.gloss: gross pay; total payment before deductions
definitions.explanation: The full amount of a salary or bonus before tax and insurance are taken out. It appears at the top of a Japanese pay slip, with {手取|てど}り (take-home pay) shown at the bottom.

examples.japanese: {総支給額|そうしきゅうがく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I check the gross pay amount.

examples.japanese: {総支給額|そうしきゅうがく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれる→引く：01978_hiku⟧。
examples.english: Taxes are deducted from the gross pay.

examples.japanese: {総支給額|そうしきゅうがく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{保険料|ほけんりょう}→保険料：11058_hokenryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{手取|てど}り→手取り：06833_tedori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦{変|か}わらなかった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: My gross pay went up, but insurance premiums rose, so my take-home pay barely changed.

notes:
⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧ (total) + ⟦{支給|しきゅう}→支給：02835_shikyuu⟧ (payment, provision) + ⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧ (amount). A pay-slip term rather than a conversational one.

PAY SLIP VOCABULARY:
- {総支給額|そうしきゅうがく}: gross pay
- ⟦{控除|こうじょ}→控除：07501_koujo⟧: deductions (tax, pension, insurance)
- {差引支給額|さしひきしきゅうがく}: net pay (the line labelled on the slip)
- ⟦{手取|てど}り→手取り：06833_tedori⟧: take-home pay (the everyday spoken word)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総支給額|そうしきゅうがく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧: gross pay increases
- {総支給額|そうしきゅうがく}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{引|ひ}かれる→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to be deducted from gross pay

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手取|てど}り→手取り：06833_tedori⟧: take-home pay — what actually reaches your account; the usual word in conversation
- ⟦{年収|ねんしゅう}→年収：05504_nenshuu⟧: annual income — normally quoted as a gross yearly figure
